report.summary: The snapshot has unresolved isolation, authorization/lease-validation, fail-closed receipt handling, and partial-installation defects.

findings.message: The supposedly isolated review provider is executed as an ordinary subprocess with only its working directory changed. It retains the runner's filesystem, process, environment, and network privileges, so a malicious or compromised provider can read secrets, mutate the original source tree or other host files, and perform external operations; the post-run hash check only detects changes inside the copied snapshot. Enforce an actual sandbox with read-only/bounded mounts, sanitized environment, and disabled network.

The provider subprocess has no timeout or other execution limit. A hung or adversarial provider can block the review/controller indefinitely and consume unbounded resources, preventing a terminal receipt. Add a configured timeout and fail closed on TimeoutExpired; apply resource limits in the sandbox.

run_review authenticates only recomputable, unkeyed hashes and bypasses the handoff verifier entirely. It does not validate the Promptcraft receipt, rendered instruction, receiver profile, resource-hash receipt, or lease expiration before launching the provider. Consequently an expired, incomplete, or locally fabricated handoff can authorize execution as long as its outer/card hashes are recomputed. Validate with verify_for_launcher (and enforce the expected receiver/role) before execution, or require a controller-authenticated envelope.

verify_for_launcher never checks that the receipt result is READY (nor validates the receipt's exact required fields). A hash-consistent receipt changed to a failure/hold result is still accepted and converted into a launcher invocation. Validate result == READY and the complete receipt schema before returning an invocation.

Adapter installation is not transactional: links are created sequentially, and any error on a later mkdir/symlink/digest operation leaves earlier capabilities installed even though the function raises and emits no accurate receipt. This can leave a harness partially materialized after an apply failure. Stage and atomically commit the full matrix, or roll back links created by the failed invocation.
